speaker: Village Elder
text: The rift tore through here three days ago. Half the town... just gone.

speaker: Village Elder
text: Your daughter... I'm sorry, Kael. She was taken to the other side.

speaker: Village Elder
text: But there may be hope. The Cogspire scholars — they've been studying the rift.

speaker: Village Elder
text: Go to Cogspire Academy, northeast of here. Ask for Professor Venn.

speaker: Village Elder
text: The scholars are our only lead. Cogspire Academy — it's your best chance.
